hook: H-K3 two-level law + harmonic mod-4 rule + generic uniformity + equianharmonic orientation
registerNote: q in {17, 19} are NOT added to the workbench; SUPPORTED_Q, the Phase-2 spec, the UI, and the regression suite are untouched. ex is relative to the pinned Blokhuis-Mazzocca odd-q minimum.
preRegistered: TL-1: all orbit ex in {(q-3)/2, (q-1)/2} at q in {17, 19}
HM-1: harmonic ex = (q-1)/2 at q=17 (1 mod 4), = (q-3)/2 at q=19 (3 mod 4)
GU-1: the two generic orbits inside each probe field are equal, both (q-3)/2
EQ-3 (weak, 2 prior points): equianharmonic at q=19 = (q-1)/2, anti-correlated with harmonic
sampling: 4 reps/orbit at probe fields (lex-first 2 + lex-last 2), 8 at controls; exact solves only
controls: q in {7, 11, 13} through the upgraded solver must reproduce PHASE3I/3J exactly
solverUpgrades: best-first child ordering + multi-order greedy seed (8 orders)
